# Crypto Polymath

> Crypto market analytics platform. It collects prices, historical candlesticks and technical indicators from six major exchanges, normalises them into a single format and adds trader calculators for position risk. Runs in the browser with no sign-up, no exchange API keys and no installation.

Supported exchanges: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Kraken, KuCoin, Gate.io. Data from every venue is normalised to the same shape, so values can be compared directly.

Interface language: English. Available worldwide. Free of charge.

## What the platform does

- Crypto prices: the latest price for an exchange and symbol pair, every price on one exchange, or one symbol across all exchanges — with a summary of the minimum, median and maximum price and the spread in percent.
- Historical candlesticks (OHLCV) on timeframes from minutes to months — as a table of values with a closing price chart.
- Heiken Ashi smoothed candlesticks for reading price movement without market noise.
- Technical indicators calculated from candlesticks: moving averages, RSI, MACD, stochastic.
- Trend analytics with a configurable lookback depth.
- Reference data: the symbol list of an exchange by category (spot, futures) and symbol details, including funding rate and next funding time.

## Trader calculators

- Average entry price when averaging by volume or by margin amount, taking leverage into account.
- Position size from margin and leverage at a given price.
- Liquidation price of an isolated position.
- Distance to liquidation as a percentage of the current price.
- Unrealized PnL of an open position and spot PnL, both in value and in percent.
- Add-on simulation: what happens to entry price, liquidation and risk after averaging down.
- Position risk snapshot at a given market price.

## Pages

- [Home](http://localhost/): feature overview and answers to frequent questions.
- [Tools](http://localhost/tools): the working page with two sections — market data and calculators. A specific function opens directly through the `?fn=` parameter, for example `http://localhost/tools?fn=risk-at-price`.
- [REST API documentation](http://localhost/docs/api): methods, parameters and responses.
- [OpenAPI contract](http://localhost/docs/api/openapi.yaml): machine-readable specification in YAML.

## Programmatic access

Every function is available through a REST API with a single contract: the same request works for any supported exchange. The base path is `/api/v1`.

Rate limits: 10 requests per minute per IP address without authentication. Pass an `X-Token` header to use the quota of the pricing plan the token was issued with. Requests over the limit are answered with HTTP 429 and a `Retry-After` header.

## Getting in touch

The home page carries a contact form: an email address to reply to, a subject and the message. It posts to `POST /api/v1/contact`, which is the documented way to ask about the data, the API or a missing feature.

## Limitations

The platform provides data and calculations. It is not investment advice, it does not execute trades and it never asks for access to a user's exchange account.
